digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation gate for bugfix-size changes
propositions: The bugfix-size attestation gate blocks large bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) unless the plan-review attestation is signed by a pinned environment, making it unsatisfiable for any developer using an unpinned (locally-reviewed) environment.

The gate's not-pinned arm returns an affirmative 'mismatch' verdict when the DSSE principal is absent from .rebar/trusted_environments.yaml, placing it in FLAG_VERDICTS and causing BLOCK classification despite a valid, signed plan review existing.

No executable path exists for a developer to obtain an acceptable attestation: the op-cert service has no client in the repo, never persists signatures, and requires a production SSM secret (X-Opcert-Guard header) to call.

The design constraint of cross-host verification via keyring lookup created an unsatisfiable criterion because only prod op-cert is pinned and contributors cannot self-serve pinning (it is CODEOWNERS-gated).

The fix removes source-of-certification verification (trusted_env_keyring lookup and verify_opcert call) and gates only on the fact of a completed, lifecycle-valid, subject-bound plan review attestation, with explicit binding re-asserted to prevent cross-ticket replay.
